title: Khung kết quả học tập và tiêu chí đạt

policy.retestPolicy: A later attempt may update mastery; retain attempt history.
policy.scopeWarning: Criteria are defined across all 11 objectives (33 criteria). Foundation (Pre-A1/A1, A2: 6/6 criteria) has criterion-aligned local evidence instrumentation (recognition, learner self-report production, delayed recall). All 9 TOEIC objectives (Grammar, Listening P1-4, Reading P5-7, Separate Part 5) have group-level runtime tracking in objectiveProgress (accuracy, durationMs, 24h/1d/3d recallDueAt), with explanation_rubric wired only on Separate Part 5 and Listening reserve items excluded; however, individual TOEIC sub-skill criteria (27/33) remain criteria_defined_not_yet_instrumented because answers are not tagged by sub-skill criterion ID and timed_accuracy does not enforce a cutoff. Instrumentation never implies CEFR/ETS certification or independent mastery.

runtimeWiring.limitations: Production rubric and recall remain learner-local/self-reported; no external CEFR/ETS certification.

outcomes.title: Nhận biết từ/cấu trúc nền tảng trong ngữ cảnh quen thuộc
